description: This guide establishes geometric-design standards and procedures for Alberta highways. Native descriptors identify PDF chapters on basic principles, alignment, cross-sections, intersections, freeways/interchanges, roadside facilities, rural roads and access management. Chapters carry different dates from 1999 through 2023, with a glossary labelled 1996. The source says chapters are being updated individually and newer chapters take precedence over contradictory older ones. This is a design-information source, not executable modelling software. Actual numerical standards, latest publisher status and complete chapter coverage were not inspected. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue carries the Alberta source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Native licence statements are Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs remain unverified. HEAD checks returned 200 for the CUDC landing page and 403 for the original Alberta landing page. No linked dataset, archive, model, document or code body was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond those explicitly described are unknown.
